title: Trump Turns Taiwan Arms Sales Into Bargaining Chip With China
key_takeaways: Taiwan has been a sensitive issue in US-China relations for decades.
Taiwan will likely feel a sense of unease and uncertainty, as its security is potentially being used as a bargaining chip.
It remains to be seen how this will play out, but one thing is certain: the US-China relationship will continue to be a major factor in the region for years to come.
